data.title: Shenlong Xing Zhu
data.synopsis:
Gu Zhengfeng was originally the divine dragon that guarded the Dragon Star. He was seriously injured in an ancient battle with alien enemies and fell into a long sleep. He wakes up and finds that the Dragon Star has changed, and is now called evil. In order to investigate and retrieve the treasure hidden in the Dragon King Academy, he changed into a human form and entered as a tutor in the Dragon Slaying Department.

(Source: TVDB)

data.synopsis:
The carefree Brother Xianyu is still enjoying an ordinary and happy daily life on Yushen Island. The gods from the Nantianmen Group broke the original peace of the island in order to investigate the stolen divine tablets. As unexpected events happened one after another, the mysteries surrounding the "Fish God" and "Seren" slowly unfolded due to Brother Xianyu's unexpected involvement. Faced with racial differences and worldly prejudices, how will Brother Xianyu use his unique way of doing things to pass this test...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

titles.title: The Mirage House in the Clouds

data.title: Yun Zhongju San Zi
data.title_english: The Mirage House in the Clouds
data.synopsis:
In an ancient world where gods, demons, and mortals coexisted, the immortal Chang'er and his apprentice Xiao Liang lived in seclusion in the Floating Light Cave. Their peaceful life was shattered by the pursuing demon king Dapeng. The timid Xiao Liang was forced to team up with the clever and cunning scholar Jiang Cheng and the resolute and stubborn monk Chongming, embarking on a journey to find the legendary immortal's abode, Cloud Dwelling. Along the way, the three would face numerous hardships, experience heart-fluttering romance, and endure trials of friendship and life-or-death situations. Meanwhile, a grand conspiracy involving forces from all three realms was unfolding around them.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
